@leyyyre It is interesting to observe the price movements of DOGE (Dogecoin) in relation to Bitcoin halving events. The fact that DOGE surged 200% before the first Bitcoin halving and 50% before the second halving indicates a potential correlation between the two cryptocurrencies.
